title: Field Sales Team Leader
summary: Field sales team leaders run a team of 5 to 15 field sales executives who sign up shops and merchants for QR codes, soundboxes, card machines or other products. They sit between the executives and the area sales manager, split the area's target across the team, go to the field with them, and check that every merchant they sign is genuine and active.
dailyDuties: Run the morning huddle and give each executive their beat and target for the day
Go to the field with executives and help close difficult merchants
Track each executive's onboardings, activations and device deployments
Audit new merchants for KYC, location and first transactions
Hire and train new executives and coach the weak performers
Send daily and weekly productivity reports to the area sales manager

skills.expectation: Lead a team of 5 or more field sales executives, run daily huddles and track each person's productivity
Drive merchant onboarding for QR, soundbox and EDC/POS devices and the quality of each acquisition
Map the market and assign beats so the team covers every pocket of the area
Split the monthly target across the team by market and product and track it daily
Go to the field with executives, meet merchants and close difficult accounts
Check merchant KYC and documents before activation and audit the team's onboardings
Keep daily productivity and target reports in Excel or Google Sheets
Hire, train and coach executives and handle attrition in the team
Pitch and train in the local language and English
Explain UPI, cards and settlement to merchants
Work with channel partners who supply or service devices
Sell loans, insurance or extra devices to active merchants
Use the company's sales app to assign leads and track visits
Collect and check the team's daily visit reports
Source and hire new field sales executives as the team grows
